WITH toy_products AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM products
    WHERE product_category_name IN (
        SELECT product_category_name
        FROM product_category_name_translation
        WHERE product_category_name_english LIKE '%toy%'
    )
),
daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        date(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'start of day') AS sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE oi.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM toy_products)
      AND date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
      AND o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY sale_date
),
date_series AS (
    SELECT date('2017-01-01', '+' || (n) || ' days') AS series_date
    FROM (
        SELECT row_number() OVER () - 1 AS n
        FROM (SELECT 1 FROM orders LIMIT 600)
    )
    WHERE series_date BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
),
regression_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(x) AS sum_x,
        SUM(y) AS sum_y,
        SUM(x * y) AS sum_xy,
        SUM(x * x) AS sum_xx
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CAST(julianday(ds.series_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INTEGER) AS x,
            COALESCE(ds2.total_sales, 0) AS y
        FROM date_series ds
        LEFT JOIN daily_sales ds2 ON ds.series_date = ds2.sale_date
    )
),
regression_coeffs AS (
    SELECT
        (sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) * 1.0 / n) / (sum_xx - (sum_x * sum_x) * 1.0 / n) AS b,
        (sum_y - ((sum_xy - (sum_x * sum_y) * 1.0 / n) / (sum_xx - (sum_x * sum_x) * 1.0 / n)) * sum_x) * 1.0 / n AS a
    FROM regression_stats
),
predict_dates AS (
    SELECT date('2018-12-05', '+' || n || ' days') AS pred_date
    FROM (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3)
),
symmetric_window AS (
    SELECT pd.pred_date, date(pd.pred_date, '-' || offset || ' days') AS window_date
    FROM predict_dates pd
    JOIN (SELECT -2 AS offset UNION ALL SELECT -1 UNION ALL SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2) off
),
date_x_values AS (
    SELECT
        window_date,
        CAST(julianday(window_date) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INTEGER) AS x
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT window_date FROM symmetric_window
    )
),
window_predictions AS (
    SELECT
        sw.pred_date,
        sw.window_date,
        rc.a + rc.b * dx.x AS predicted_sales
    FROM symmetric_window sw
    JOIN date_x_values dx ON sw.window_date = dx.window_date
    CROSS JOIN regression_coeffs rc
),
moving_avg_5d AS (
    SELECT
        pred_date,
        AVG(predicted_sales) AS movavg_5d
    FROM window_predictions
    GROUP BY pred_date
)
SELECT SUM(movavg_5d) AS sum_of_5d_moving_averages
FROM moving_avg_5d
WHERE pred_date BETWEEN '2018-12-05' AND '2018-12-08';

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_order_stats AS (
    SELECT
        do.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT do.order_id) AS frequency,
        MAX(do.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
        SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS monetary
    FROM delivered_orders do
    JOIN order_items oi ON do.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY do.customer_id
),
reference_date AS (
    -- Use latest delivered order as the reference for recency calculation
    SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_date FROM delivered_orders
),
customer_rfm_raw AS (
    SELECT
        cos.customer_id,
        JULIANDAY((SELECT max_date FROM reference_date)) - JULIANDAY(cos.last_purchase) AS recency_days,
        cos.frequency,
        cos.monetary
    FROM customer_order_stats cos
),
rfm_scores AS (
    -- Assign R, F, M scores (1 = best, 5 = worst) using quintiles
    SELECT
        r.*,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) AS recency_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS frequency_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS monetary_score
    FROM customer_rfm_raw r
),
rfm_segments AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        (recency_score) || (frequency_score) || (monetary_score) AS rfm_cell,
        CASE
            -- Champions
            WHEN recency_score = 1 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4
                THEN 'Champions'
            -- Can't Lose Them
            WHEN (recency_score = 4 OR recency_score = 5) AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2
                THEN "Can't Lose Them"
            -- Hibernating
            WHEN (recency_score = 4 OR recency_score = 5) AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6
                THEN 'Hibernating'
            -- Lost
            WHEN (recency_score = 4 OR recency_score = 5) AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10
                THEN 'Lost'
            -- Loyal Customers
            WHEN (recency_score = 2 OR recency_score = 3) AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4
                THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            -- Needs Attention
            WHEN recency_score = 3 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6
                THEN 'Needs Attention'
            -- Recent Users
            WHEN recency_score = 1 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8
                THEN 'Recent Users'
            -- Potential Loyalists
            WHEN (recency_score = 1 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
               OR (recency_score = 2 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8)
                THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            -- Price Sensitive
            WHEN recency_score = 1 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10
                THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            -- Promising
            WHEN recency_score = 2 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10
                THEN 'Promising'
            -- About to Sleep
            WHEN recency_score = 3 AND (frequency_score + monetary_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10
                THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scores
),
customer_avg_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        r.rfm_segment,
        r.monetary,
        r.frequency,
        CASE WHEN r.frequency > 0 THEN CAST(r.monetary AS FLOAT)/r.frequency ELSE NULL END AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM rfm_segments r
    JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
SELECT
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count,
    AVG(avg_sales_per_order) AS avg_sales_per_order
FROM customer_avg_sales
WHERE rfm_segment != 'Other'
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC;

WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_id,
        DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_date
    FROM orders o
),
payment_per_order AS (
    SELECT
        op.order_id,
        SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment
    FROM order_payments op
    GROUP BY op.order_id
),
customer_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        co.customer_id,
        COUNT(co.order_id) AS num_orders,
        AVG(ppo.total_payment) AS avg_payment_per_order,
        MIN(co.order_date) AS first_purchase,
        MAX(co.order_date) AS last_purchase
    FROM customer_orders co
    LEFT JOIN payment_per_order ppo ON co.order_id = ppo.order_id
    GROUP BY co.customer_id
),
customer_lifespan AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        num_orders,
        avg_payment_per_order,
        first_purchase,
        last_purchase,
        CASE
            WHEN julianday(last_purchase) - julianday(first_purchase) < 7 THEN 1.0
            ELSE ROUND((julianday(last_purchase) - julianday(first_purchase)) / 7.0, 1)
        END AS lifespan_weeks
    FROM customer_aggregates
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    num_orders,
    ROUND(avg_payment_per_order, 2) AS avg_payment_per_order,
    lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_lifespan
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH player_dates AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    debut,
    final_game
  FROM player
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL
),
career_spans AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    ROUND(ABS(CAST(strftime('%Y', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', debut) AS INTEGER)), 2) AS years_diff,
    ROUND(ABS(CAST(strftime('%m', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', debut) AS INTEGER)), 2) AS months_diff,
    ROUND(ABS(CAST(strftime('%d', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%d', debut) AS INTEGER)), 2) AS days_diff
  FROM player_dates
),
career_span_floats AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    years_diff +
    ROUND(months_diff / 12.0, 2) +
    ROUND(days_diff / 365.0, 2) AS career_span
  FROM career_spans
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) AS avg_single_career_span_float_years
FROM career_span_floats;

WITH max_values AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(g) AS max_games,
    MAX(r) AS max_runs,
    MAX(h) AS max_hits,
    MAX(hr) AS max_home_runs
  FROM batting
),
leaders AS (
  SELECT
    b.player_id,
    CASE WHEN b.g = mv.max_games THEN 'games' END AS category,
    b.g AS score
  FROM batting b, max_values mv
  WHERE b.g = mv.max_games
  UNION
  SELECT
    b.player_id,
    CASE WHEN b.r = mv.max_runs THEN 'runs' END AS category,
    b.r AS score
  FROM batting b, max_values mv
  WHERE b.r = mv.max_runs
  UNION
  SELECT
    b.player_id,
    CASE WHEN b.h = mv.max_hits THEN 'hits' END AS category,
    b.h AS score
  FROM batting b, max_values mv
  WHERE b.h = mv.max_hits
  UNION
  SELECT
    b.player_id,
    CASE WHEN b.hr = mv.max_home_runs THEN 'home_runs' END AS category,
    b.hr AS score
  FROM batting b, max_values mv
  WHERE b.hr = mv.max_home_runs
)
SELECT
  p.name_given,
  l.category,
  l.score
FROM leaders l
JOIN player p ON l.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY l.category, l.score DESC, p.name_given
;

WITH abakan_airports AS (
  SELECT airport_code
  FROM airports_data
  WHERE json_extract(city, '$.en') = 'Abakan'
),
relevant_flights AS (
  SELECT flight_no, departure_airport, arrival_airport
  FROM flights
  WHERE departure_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM abakan_airports)
     OR arrival_airport IN (SELECT airport_code FROM abakan_airports)
),
airports_with_coords AS (
  SELECT airport_code, json_extract(city, '$.en') AS city,
         CAST(substr(coordinates, 2, instr(coordinates, ',')-2) AS FLOAT) AS longitude,
         CAST(substr(coordinates, instr(coordinates, ',')+1, length(coordinates)-instr(coordinates, ',')-1) AS FLOAT) AS latitude
  FROM airports_data
),
flights_with_coords AS (
  SELECT
    f.flight_no,
    da.city AS departure_city, da.latitude AS dep_lat, da.longitude AS dep_lon,
    aa.city AS arrival_city, aa.latitude AS arr_lat, aa.longitude AS arr_lon
  FROM relevant_flights f
  JOIN airports_with_coords da ON f.departure_airport = da.airport_code
  JOIN airports_with_coords aa ON f.arrival_airport = aa.airport_code
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN departure_city < arrival_city THEN departure_city ELSE arrival_city END AS city1,
    CASE WHEN departure_city < arrival_city THEN arrival_city ELSE departure_city END AS city2,
    dep_lat, dep_lon, arr_lat, arr_lon
  FROM flights_with_coords
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
distances AS (
  SELECT city1, city2,
    2 * 6371 * asin(
      sqrt(
        pow(sin(radians((arr_lat - dep_lat) / 2)), 2) + 
        cos(radians(dep_lat)) * cos(radians(arr_lat)) * 
        pow(sin(radians((arr_lon - dep_lon) / 2)), 2)
      )
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM city_pairs
  WHERE city1 = 'Abakan' OR city2 = 'Abakan'
)
SELECT MAX(distance_km) AS longest_route_distance_km FROM distances
LIMIT 1

WITH airport_cities AS (
    SELECT 
        airport_code, 
        json_extract(city, '$.en') AS city_en,
        TRIM(SUBSTR(coordinates, 1, INSTR(coordinates, ',') - 1)) * 1.0 AS longitude,
        TRIM(SUBSTR(coordinates, INSTR(coordinates, ',') + 1)) * 1.0 AS latitude
    FROM airports_data
),
flight_city_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        f.flight_id,
        dep.city_en AS dep_city,
        arr.city_en AS arr_city,
        dep.longitude AS dep_long,
        dep.latitude AS dep_lat,
        arr.longitude AS arr_long,
        arr.latitude AS arr_lat
    FROM flights f
    JOIN airport_cities dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
    JOIN airport_cities arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
    WHERE dep.city_en <> arr.city_en
),
city_pairs_dedup AS (
    SELECT
        flight_id,
        CASE WHEN dep_city < arr_city THEN dep_city ELSE arr_city END AS city1,
        CASE WHEN dep_city < arr_city THEN arr_city ELSE dep_city END AS city2,
        CASE WHEN dep_city < arr_city THEN dep_long ELSE arr_long END AS long1,
        CASE WHEN dep_city < arr_city THEN dep_lat ELSE arr_lat END AS lat1,
        CASE WHEN dep_city < arr_city THEN arr_long ELSE dep_long END AS long2,
        CASE WHEN dep_city < arr_city THEN arr_lat ELSE dep_lat END AS lat2
    FROM flight_city_pairs
),
pair_distances AS (
    SELECT
        city1, city2,
        2 * 6371 *
          ASIN(
            MIN(
              1,
              SQRT(
                POW(SIN(RADIANS(lat2-lat1)/2),2) +
                COS(RADIANS(lat1)) * COS(RADIANS(lat2)) *
                POW(SIN(RADIANS(long2-long1)/2),2)
              )
            )
          ) AS distance
    FROM city_pairs_dedup
),
all_pair_avg AS (
    SELECT
        city1,
        city2,
        AVG(distance) as avg_distance
    FROM (
        SELECT
            city1,
            city2,
            2 * 6371 *
              ASIN(
                MIN(
                  1,
                  SQRT(
                    POW(SIN(RADIANS(lat2-lat1)/2),2) +
                    COS(RADIANS(lat1)) * COS(RADIANS(lat2)) *
                    POW(SIN(RADIANS(long2-long1)/2),2)
                  )
                )
              ) AS distance
        FROM city_pairs_dedup
    )
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
range_buckets AS (
    SELECT
        city1,
        city2,
        avg_distance,
        CASE
            WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0'
            WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
            ELSE '6000+'
        END AS distance_range
    FROM all_pair_avg
),
range_counts AS (
    SELECT distance_range, COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM range_buckets
    GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT pair_count
FROM range_counts
WHERE pair_count = (
    SELECT MIN(pair_count) FROM range_counts
)
LIMIT 1;

WITH motorcycle_parties AS (
  SELECT
    case_id,
    party_number,
    -- Determining helmet usage: Assume 'Helmet' or codes containing 'Helmet' denote helmet use
    CASE
      WHEN (party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%Helmet%' OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%Helmet%') THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS helmet_used
  FROM parties
  WHERE statewide_vehicle_type LIKE '%Motorcycle%'
),
collision_helmet_groups AS (
  SELECT
    case_id,
    MAX(helmet_used) as any_helmet_used,
    MIN(helmet_used) as all_helmet_used
  FROM motorcycle_parties
  GROUP BY case_id
),
motorcycle_victim_fatalities AS (
  SELECT
    v.case_id,
    v.party_number
  FROM victims v
  JOIN parties p
    ON v.case_id = p.case_id AND v.party_number = p.party_number
  WHERE p.statewide_vehicle_type LIKE '%Motorcycle%'
    AND v.victim_degree_of_injury = 'Killed'
),
fatalities_by_helmet AS (
  SELECT
    chg.any_helmet_used AS helmet_used,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mvf.id) AS fatalities,
    COUNT(DISTINCT chg.case_id) AS total_collisions
  FROM collision_helmet_groups chg
  LEFT JOIN motorcycle_victim_fatalities mvf
    ON chg.case_id = mvf.case_id
  GROUP BY helmet_used
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN helmet_used = 1 THEN 'Helmet used in collision' ELSE 'No helmet used in collision' END as helmet_group,
  COALESCE(CAST(fatalities AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(total_collisions, 0) * 100, 0) as fatality_rate_percent
FROM fatalities_by_helmet
ORDER BY helmet_used DESC;

WITH incident_counts AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) AS incident_count
  FROM collisions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', collision_date) IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY year, pcf_violation_category
),
year_totals AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    SUM(incident_count) AS total_incidents
  FROM incident_counts
  GROUP BY year
),
category_shares AS (
  SELECT
    ic.year,
    ic.pcf_violation_category,
    ic.incident_count,
    yt.total_incidents,
    100.0 * ic.incident_count / yt.total_incidents AS share_percent
  FROM incident_counts ic
  JOIN year_totals yt ON ic.year = yt.year
),
most_common_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    pcf_violation_category
  FROM category_shares
  WHERE year = '2021'
  ORDER BY share_percent DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
shares_2011_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    cs.year,
    cs.share_percent
  FROM category_shares cs
  JOIN most_common_2021 mc ON cs.pcf_violation_category = mc.pcf_violation_category
  WHERE cs.year IN ('2011', '2021')
  ORDER BY cs.year
)
SELECT
  (SELECT share_percent FROM shares_2011_2021 WHERE year = '2021') -
  (SELECT share_percent FROM shares_2011_2021 WHERE year = '2011') AS percentage_point_change
;

SELECT m.title_id AS nxt_title,
       w1.name AS wrestler_1,
       w2.name AS wrestler_2
FROM Matches m
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id
WHERE m.title_id LIKE '%NXT%'
  AND m.title_change = 0
  AND CAST(m.duration AS INTEGER) = (
      SELECT MIN(CAST(duration AS INTEGER))
      FROM Matches
      WHERE title_id LIKE '%NXT%'
        AND title_change = 0
  )
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs,0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS bowling_average
FROM 
    wicket_taken wt
JOIN 
    ball_by_ball bbb ON wt.match_id = bbb.match_id AND wt.innings_no = bbb.innings_no 
                         AND wt.over_id = bbb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bbb.ball_id
JOIN 
    player p ON bbb.bowler = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN 
    batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no 
                       AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
LEFT JOIN 
    extra_runs er ON bbb.match_id = er.match_id AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no 
                   AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id
GROUP BY 
    p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH striker_match_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.striker,
        bb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM 
        ball_by_ball bb
        JOIN batsman_scored bs ON 
            bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND 
            bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no AND 
            bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND 
            bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY 
        bb.striker,
        bb.match_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) AS average_runs
FROM (
    SELECT total_runs
    FROM striker_match_scores
    WHERE total_runs > 50
)
;

WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM match
    WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT
        bs.match_id,
        bs.innings_no,
        bs.over_id,
        bs.ball_id,
        bs.runs_scored,
        pm.player_id
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN season5_matches sm ON bs.match_id = sm.match_id
    JOIN player_match pm ON bs.match_id = pm.match_id
        AND pm.player_id = (SELECT p.player_id FROM player p WHERE p.player_id = pm.player_id)
),
agg_player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_batting_avg AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        total_runs * 1.0 / matches_played AS batting_average
    FROM agg_player_runs
    WHERE matches_played > 0
)
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    ROUND(pba.batting_average, 2) AS batting_average
FROM player_batting_avg pba
JOIN player p ON pba.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY pba.batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON pm.match_id = bs.match_id AND pm.player_id = bs.player_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT
        pr.player_id,
        CAST(pr.total_runs AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(pr.matches_played, 0) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs pr
    WHERE pr.matches_played > 0
),
player_country AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.country_name
    FROM player p
),
country_player_avgs AS (
    SELECT
        pc.country_name,
        pa.avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_avg pa
    JOIN player_country pc ON pa.player_id = pc.player_id
)
SELECT
    country_name,
    AVG(avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_avg
FROM country_player_avgs
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY country_batting_avg DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.over_id,
        b.bowler,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id
        AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
        AND b.over_id = er.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler
),
max_over_per_match AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        over_id,
        bowler,
        total_runs
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id) AS rn
        FROM over_runs
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_runs) AS avg_highest_over_runs_across_matches
FROM max_over_per_match;

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.over_id,
        b.bowler,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + IFNULL(SUM(er.extra_runs),0) AS total_runs
    FROM
        ball_by_ball b
        LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY
        b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler
),
max_over_by_match AS (
    SELECT
        o.match_id,
        o.innings_no,
        o.over_id,
        o.bowler,
        o.total_runs
    FROM
        over_runs o
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT
                match_id,
                MAX(total_runs) AS max_runs_in_over
            FROM
                over_runs
            GROUP BY
                match_id
        ) om
        ON o.match_id = om.match_id AND o.total_runs = om.max_runs_in_over
)

    p.player_name AS bowler_name,
    m.match_id,
    mo.total_runs AS runs_conceded_in_over
FROM

LIMIT 3;

WITH ordered_cities AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      geolocation_state,
      geolocation_city,
      geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
      AVG(geolocation_lat) AS geolocation_lat,
      AVG(geolocation_lng) AS geolocation_lng
    FROM olist_geolocation
    GROUP BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix
  )
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    curr.geolocation_state AS state1,
    curr.geolocation_city AS city1,
    curr.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip1,
    curr.geolocation_lat AS lat1,
    curr.geolocation_lng AS lng1,
    prev.geolocation_state AS state2,
    prev.geolocation_city AS city2,
    prev.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip2,
    prev.geolocation_lat AS lat2,
    prev.geolocation_lng AS lng2,
    6371 * ACOS(
      COS(RADIANS(curr.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(prev.geolocation_lat)) *
      COS(RADIANS(prev.geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(curr.geolocation_lng)) +
      SIN(RADIANS(curr.geolocation_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(prev.geolocation_lat))
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM ordered_cities curr
  JOIN ordered_cities prev ON curr.rn = prev.rn + 1
)
SELECT
  state1, city1, zip1, lat1, lng1,
  state2, city2, zip2, lat2, lng2,
  distance_km
FROM city_pairs
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH base_sales AS (

    s.prod_id,

    t.calendar_year AS year,
    s.amount_sold,
    s.channel_id,
    s.promo_id,
    c.country_id,
    co.country_name
  FROM sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND s.promo_id = 1
    AND s.channel_id = 1
),
pivot_sales AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS amt_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS amt_2020
  FROM base_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, month
),
projected_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    month,
    CASE
      WHEN amt_2019 != 0 THEN (((amt_2020 - amt_2019) / amt_2019) * amt_2020) + amt_2020
      ELSE amt_2020
    END AS projected_amt_2021
  FROM pivot_sales
),
proj_with_currency AS (
  SELECT
    p.prod_id,
    p.month,
    ROUND(
      p.projected_amt_2021 * COALESCE(cur.to_us, 1), 2
    ) AS projected_usd
  FROM projected_2021 p
  LEFT JOIN currency cur ON cur.country = 'France' AND cur.year = 2020 AND cur.month = p.month
),
monthly_avg_usd AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    AVG(projected_usd) AS avg_usd
  FROM proj_with_currency
  GROUP BY month
),
ordered_avg AS (
  SELECT
    avg_usd,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_usd) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
  FROM monthly_avg_usd
)

FROM ordered_avg
WHERE rn = (total + 1) / 2

WITH BestSellingArtist AS (

WITH artist_sales AS (

),
ranked_artists AS (

top_artist AS (

low_artist AS (

),
customer_artist_spending AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId,

top_artist_avg AS (

low_artist_avg AS (

WITH
-- Join sales to times, customers, countries to get US, quarter info, and city
sales_with_context AS (
  SELECT
    s.cust_id,

    s.amount_sold,
    t.calendar_year,
    t.calendar_quarter_number,
    s.promo_id
  FROM sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States'
    AND ((t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4)
         OR (t.calendar_year = 2020 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4))
    AND s.promo_id = 0
),

-- City sales per quarter (2019 Q4 and 2020 Q4 only, no promotion)
city_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT city, calendar_year, SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM sales_with_context
  GROUP BY city, calendar_year
),

-- Select cities with at least 20% increase from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020
cities_growth AS (
  SELECT a.city, a.total_sales AS sales_2019, b.total_sales AS sales_2020
  FROM 
    (SELECT city, total_sales FROM city_quarter_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2019) a
    INNER JOIN 
    (SELECT city, total_sales FROM city_quarter_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020) b
    ON a.city = b.city
  WHERE a.total_sales > 0 AND (b.total_sales - a.total_sales) * 1.0 / a.total_sales >= 0.2
),

-- All relevant sales in those cities in Q4 of 2019 and 2020 (no promotion)
filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT swc.*
  FROM sales_with_context swc
  JOIN cities_growth cg ON swc.city = cg.city
),

-- Product total sales (in all those cities, over both Q4 periods)
product_sales_total AS (
  SELECT prod_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS sales_total
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),

-- Rank products by overall sales and top 20% cutoff (ties included)
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, sales_total,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sales_total DESC) AS rnk,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_products
  FROM product_sales_total
),
top_20pct_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id
  FROM ranked_products
  WHERE rnk <= CAST(total_products * 0.2 + 0.9999 AS INTEGER)
),

-- Sales by product per quarter for the top group
top_product_sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT fs.prod_id, fs.calendar_year, SUM(fs.amount_sold) AS prod_sales
  FROM filtered_sales fs
  JOIN top_20pct_products tp ON fs.prod_id = tp.prod_id
  GROUP BY fs.prod_id, fs.calendar_year
),

total_sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT calendar_year, SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY calendar_year
),

-- Share of each top product on each year
product_share_by_year AS (
  SELECT tps.prod_id, tps.calendar_year, tps.prod_sales * 1.0 / tsby.total_sales AS share
  FROM top_product_sales_by_year tps
  JOIN total_sales_by_year tsby ON tps.calendar_year = tsby.calendar_year
),

-- Reshape and calculate share changes
product_share_change AS (
  SELECT
    p.prod_id,
    p2019.share AS share_2019,
    p2020.share AS share_2020,
    (p2020.share - p2019.share) AS share_change
  FROM
    (SELECT * FROM product_share_by_year WHERE calendar_year = 2019) p2019
    JOIN (SELECT * FROM product_share_by_year WHERE calendar_year = 2020) p2020
      ON p2019.prod_id = p2020.prod_id
    JOIN products p ON p2019.prod_id = p.prod_id
)
SELECT psc.prod_id, pr.prod_name, psc.share_2019, psc.share_2020, psc.share_change
FROM product_share_change psc
JOIN products pr ON psc.prod_id = pr.prod_id
ORDER BY psc.share_change DESC
LIMIT 1000

WITH
filtered_sales AS (

  JOIN countries c ON s.cust_id = c.country_id
  WHERE
    c.country_name = 'France'

    AND s.channel_id = 1
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
),
monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    month,
    year,
    SUM(amount_sold) AS total_amount
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, year, month
),
pivoted_sales AS (
  SELECT
    a.prod_id,
    a.month,
    IFNULL(a.total_amount, 0) AS amt_2019,
    IFNULL(b.total_amount, 0) AS amt_2020
  FROM
    (SELECT * FROM monthly_sales WHERE year = 2019) a
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM monthly_sales WHERE year = 2020) b
    ON a.prod_id = b.prod_id AND a.month = b.month

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    b.prod_id,
    b.month,
    IFNULL(a.total_amount, 0) AS amt_2019,
    IFNULL(b.total_amount, 0) AS amt_2020
  FROM
    (SELECT * FROM monthly_sales WHERE year = 2020) b
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM monthly_sales WHERE year = 2019) a
    ON b.prod_id = a.prod_id AND b.month = a.month
  WHERE a.prod_id IS NULL
),
projected_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    month,
    amt_2019,
    amt_2020,
    CASE
      WHEN amt_2019 != 0 THEN (((amt_2020 - amt_2019) * 1.0) / amt_2019) * amt_2020 + amt_2020
      ELSE amt_2020
    END AS proj_2021_amt
  FROM pivoted_sales
),
fx AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    to_us
  FROM currency
  WHERE country = 'France' AND year = 2021
),
projected_with_fx AS (
  SELECT
    p.month,
    p.prod_id,
    p.proj_2021_amt,
    IFNULL(f.to_us, 1) AS to_usd,
    ROUND(p.proj_2021_amt * IFNULL(f.to_us, 1), 2) AS proj_2021_usd
  FROM projected_2021 p
  LEFT JOIN fx f ON p.month = f.month
)
SELECT
  month,
  ROUND(AVG(proj_2021_usd), 2) AS avg_projected_2021_usd
FROM projected_with_fx
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH italian_customers AS (

),
dec_2021_profits AS (

  FROM sales s

profit_stats AS (

  FROM dec_2021_profits
),
bucketed_profits AS (

    d.cust_id,
    d.total_profit,
    CAST(
      1 + (9.0 * (d.total_profit - ps.min_profit) 
           / CASE WHEN ps.max_profit = ps.min_profit THEN 1 ELSE (ps.max_profit - ps.min_profit) END
      ) AS INTEGER
    ) AS profit_bucket
  FROM dec_2021_profits d
  CROSS JOIN profit_stats ps
)
SELECT
  profit_bucket,

WITH month_txns AS (

  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
  GROUP BY customer_id, ym
),
month_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    ym,

  FROM month_txns
),
month_positive_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ym,

  FROM month_balances
  WHERE month_end_balance > 0
  GROUP BY ym
),
extreme_months AS (
  SELECT
    'max' AS tag,
    ym,
    positive_count
  FROM month_positive_counts
  WHERE positive_count = (SELECT MAX(positive_count) FROM month_positive_counts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'min' AS tag,

month_avgs AS (

)
SELECT

  (SELECT ym FROM month_avgs WHERE tag = 'max') AS month_highest_positive_customers,

WITH monthly_cities AS (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y', insert_date) AS year,
    STRFTIME('%m', insert_date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS cities_added
  FROM cities
  WHERE STRFTIME('%m', insert_date) IN ('04', '05', '06')
    AND STRFTIME('%Y', insert_date) IN ('2021','2022','2023')
  GROUP BY year, month
),
running_totals AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    year,
    cities_added,
    SUM(cities_added) OVER (
      PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_total
  FROM monthly_cities
),
growth_calc AS (
  SELECT
    rt.year,
    rt.month,
    rt.cities_added,
    rt.running_total,
    LAG(rt.cities_added) OVER (PARTITION BY rt.month ORDER BY rt.year) AS prev_cities_added,
    LAG(rt.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY rt.month ORDER BY rt.year) AS prev_running_total
  FROM running_totals rt
)
SELECT
  year,
  CASE month
    WHEN '04' THEN 'April'
    WHEN '05' THEN 'May'
    WHEN '06' THEN 'June'
    ELSE month
  END AS month,
  cities_added AS monthly_total,
  running_total AS cumulative_running_total,
  CASE
    WHEN prev_cities_added IS NOT NULL AND prev_cities_added > 0
      THEN ROUND(100.0 * (cities_added - prev_cities_added) / prev_cities_added, 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS yoy_growth_monthly_total_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN prev_running_total IS NOT NULL AND prev_running_total > 0
      THEN ROUND(100.0 * (running_total - prev_running_total) / prev_running_total, 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS yoy_growth_cumulative_running_total_pct
FROM growth_calc
WHERE year IN ('2022', '2023')
ORDER BY year, month

WITH months AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(DATE(strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date))) as min_month,
        MAX(DATE(strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date))) as max_month
    FROM customer_transactions
), month_list AS (
    -- Generate list of months between min and max
    WITH RECURSIVE ml(month) AS (
        SELECT min_month FROM months
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATE(strftime('%Y-%m-01', DATE(month, '+1 month')))
        FROM ml, months
        WHERE month < max_month
    )
    SELECT month FROM ml
), customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
), customer_months AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id, 
        m.month
    FROM customers c
    CROSS JOIN month_list m
), txn_months AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id, 
        DATE(strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date)) as month, 
        SUM(txn_amount) as month_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
), month_balances AS (
    SELECT
        cm.customer_id,
        cm.month,
        COALESCE(tm.month_change, 0) as month_change
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN txn_months tm
        ON cm.customer_id = tm.customer_id AND cm.month = tm.month
), ordered AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month,
        month_change,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as rn
    FROM month_balances
), initial_balance AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        IFNULL(SUM(txn_amount), 0) as start_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date < (SELECT min_month FROM months)
    GROUP BY customer_id
), cumulative AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.month,
        o.month_change,
        COALESCE(ib.start_balance, 0) + SUM(o.month_change) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as month_end_balance
    FROM ordered o
    LEFT JOIN initial_balance ib ON o.customer_id = ib.customer_id
)
SELECT

    month as closing_month,
    month_change as monthly_changes,
    month_end_balance as monthly_closing_balance
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY customer_id, month;

    FROM interest_metrics m

),
max_monthly_interest AS (

rolling_max AS (

    FROM max_per_month mp

SELECT

  SELECT

    y AS yr
  FROM
    ActorYearRange a
    JOIN (
      SELECT 1900 + n AS y FROM (
        SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () - 1 AS n FROM (
          SELECT 1 FROM M_Cast LIMIT 201
        )
      ) WHERE n <= 200
    ) years
    ON y BETWEEN a.min_year AND a.max_year
),
ActorYearMatrix AS (
  SELECT
    ys.PID,
    ys.yr,
    CASE WHEN ay.yr IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_credit
  FROM
    YearSeries ys
    LEFT JOIN ActorYears ay
      ON ys.PID = ay.PID AND ys.yr = ay.yr
),
ActorGaps AS (
  SELECT
    a.PID,
    a.yr AS gap_start
  FROM
    ActorYearMatrix a
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM ActorYearMatrix b
      WHERE b.PID = a.PID AND b.yr BETWEEN a.yr AND a.yr+3 AND b.has_credit = 1
    )
),
ActorsWithBadGaps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM ActorGaps
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.PID) AS num_actors_without_long_gaps
FROM ActorYears a
WHERE a.PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM ActorsWithBadGaps)
;

WITH yash_chopra_pid AS (

),
actor_director_films AS (

),
actor_max_films_with_director AS (

),
actors_more_with_yash_chopra AS (

WITH region_orders AS (
    SELECT
        wr.id AS region_id,
        wr.name AS region_name,
        COUNT(wo.id) AS num_orders,
        COALESCE(SUM(wo.total_amt_usd), 0) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM web_region wr
    LEFT JOIN web_sales_reps ws ON wr.id = ws.region_id
    LEFT JOIN web_orders wo ON ws.id = wo.account_id
    GROUP BY wr.id, wr.name
),
rep_sales AS (
    SELECT
        wr.id AS region_id,
        ws.id AS sales_rep_id,
        ws.name AS sales_rep_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(wo.total_amt_usd), 0) AS rep_sales_amount
    FROM web_region wr
    JOIN web_sales_reps ws ON ws.region_id = wr.id
    LEFT JOIN web_orders wo ON ws.id = wo.account_id
    GROUP BY wr.id, ws.id, ws.name
),
region_max_sales AS (
    SELECT
        region_id,
        MAX(rep_sales_amount) AS max_sales_amount
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_id
)
SELECT
    ro.region_name,
    ro.num_orders,
    ro.total_sales_amount,
    rs.sales_rep_name,
    rs.rep_sales_amount
FROM region_orders ro
LEFT JOIN rep_sales rs ON ro.region_id = rs.region_id
LEFT JOIN region_max_sales rms 
    ON rs.region_id = rms.region_id AND rs.rep_sales_amount = rms.max_sales_amount
WHERE rs.sales_rep_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ro.region_name, rs.sales_rep_name

WITH winner_games AS (

  WHERE bs.HandiCapScore <= 190

),
bowlers_with_all_three_venues AS (

)
SELECT

ORDER BY wg.BowlerID, wg.TourneyDate, wg.MatchID, wg.GameNumber;

SELECT
  ms.StyleName,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS First_Preference_Count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Second_Preference_Count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Third_Preference_Count
FROM Musical_Styles ms
LEFT JOIN Musical_Preferences mp ON ms.StyleID = mp.StyleID
GROUP BY ms.StyleName
ORDER BY ms.StyleName;

WITH Entertainer_StyleCounts AS (
  SELECT EntertainerID, COUNT(*) AS style_count
  FROM Entertainer_Styles
  GROUP BY EntertainerID
  HAVING style_count <= 3
),
Customer_PrefCounts AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(*) AS pref_count
  FROM Musical_Preferences
  GROUP BY CustomerID
  HAVING pref_count <= 3
),
EntFirstSecond AS (
  SELECT e.EntertainerID, 
         MAX(CASE WHEN es.StyleStrength = 1 THEN es.StyleID END) AS EStyle1,
         MAX(CASE WHEN es.StyleStrength = 2 THEN es.StyleID END) AS EStyle2
  FROM Entertainers e
  JOIN Entertainer_StyleCounts esc ON e.EntertainerID = esc.EntertainerID
  JOIN Entertainer_Styles es ON e.EntertainerID = es.EntertainerID
  GROUP BY e.EntertainerID
),
CustFirstSecond AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID,
         MAX(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN mp.StyleID END) AS CStyle1,
         MAX(CASE WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN mp.StyleID END) AS CStyle2
  FROM Customers c
  JOIN Customer_PrefCounts cpc ON c.CustomerID = cpc.CustomerID
  JOIN Musical_Preferences mp ON c.CustomerID = mp.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
)
SELECT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
FROM Entertainers e
JOIN EntFirstSecond ef ON e.EntertainerID = ef.EntertainerID
JOIN CustFirstSecond cf
  ON ( (ef.EStyle1 = cf.CStyle1 AND ef.EStyle2 = cf.CStyle2)
        OR (ef.EStyle1 = cf.CStyle2 AND ef.EStyle2 = cf.CStyle1) )
JOIN Customers c ON cf.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

WITH StyleScores AS (
    SELECT
        mp.StyleID,
        SUM(
            CASE mp.PreferenceSeq 
                WHEN 1 THEN 3
                WHEN 2 THEN 2
                WHEN 3 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_weighted_score
    FROM Musical_Preferences mp
    WHERE mp.PreferenceSeq IN (1,2,3)
    GROUP BY mp.StyleID
),
AvgScore AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_weighted_score * 1.0) AS avg_total_score 
    FROM StyleScores
)
SELECT
    ms.StyleID,
    ms.StyleName,
    ss.total_weighted_score,
    ABS(ss.total_weighted_score - a.avg_total_score) AS abs_difference_from_average
FROM StyleScores ss
JOIN Musical_Styles ms ON ms.StyleID = ss.StyleID
CROSS JOIN AvgScore a
ORDER BY ss.total_weighted_score DESC, ms.StyleID;

WITH director_movies AS (
  SELECT
    dm.name_id AS director_id,
    n.name AS director_name,
    m.id AS movie_id,
    m.duration AS movie_duration,
    m.year AS movie_year,
    r.avg_rating,
    r.total_votes
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
  JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
  LEFT JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
),
inter_movie_gap AS (
  SELECT
    director_id,
    director_name,
    movie_id,
    movie_duration,
    avg_rating,
    total_votes,
    movie_year,
    movie_year - LAG(movie_year) OVER (PARTITION BY director_id ORDER BY movie_year) AS diff
  FROM director_movies
  WHERE movie_year IS NOT NULL
),
director_stats AS (
  SELECT
    director_id,
    director_name,
    COUNT(movie_id) AS movie_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(movie_duration,0)) AS total_movie_duration,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_rating),2) AS avg_rating,
    SUM(COALESCE(total_votes,0)) AS total_votes,
    MIN(avg_rating) AS min_rating,
    MAX(avg_rating) AS max_rating,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(diff) > 0 THEN ROUND(AVG(diff)) ELSE NULL END AS avg_inter_movie_duration
  FROM inter_movie_gap
  GROUP BY director_id, director_name
)
SELECT
  director_id,
  director_name,
  movie_count,
  avg_inter_movie_duration,
  avg_rating,
  total_votes,
  min_rating,
  max_rating,
  total_movie_duration
FROM director_stats
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9;

WITH cleaned_prices AS (
    SELECT
        market_date AS date,
        ticker,
        CASE
            WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0.0
            WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000
            WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000000
            ELSE CAST(volume AS FLOAT)
        END AS clean_volume
    FROM bitcoin_prices
    WHERE market_date BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND '2021-08-10'
),
ranked_prices AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        ticker,
        clean_volume,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ticker, date ORDER BY date) AS rn
    FROM cleaned_prices
),
nonzero_volumes AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        ticker,
        clean_volume,
        LAG(date) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY date) AS prev_date,
        LAG(clean_volume) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY date) AS prev_volume
    FROM (
        SELECT * FROM ranked_prices WHERE clean_volume > 0
    )
),
full_daily_changes AS (
    SELECT
        cp.date,
        cp.ticker,
        cp.clean_volume,
        (
            SELECT nzv_prev.clean_volume
            FROM nonzero_volumes nzv_prev
            WHERE nzv_prev.ticker = cp.ticker AND nzv_prev.date < cp.date
            ORDER BY nzv_prev.date DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS prev_nonzero_volume
    FROM cleaned_prices cp
)
SELECT
    date,
    ticker,
    clean_volume AS volume,
    prev_nonzero_volume,
    CASE
        WHEN prev_nonzero_volume IS NOT NULL AND prev_nonzero_volume != 0
            THEN ROUND((clean_volume - prev_nonzero_volume) / prev_nonzero_volume * 100, 4)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS pct_change
FROM full_daily_changes
ORDER BY ticker, date;

WITH rank_avg AS (
    SELECT
        FacRank,
        AVG(FacSalary) AS avg_salary
    FROM university_faculty
    GROUP BY FacRank
),
faculty_diff AS (
    SELECT
        uf.FacRank,
        uf.FacFirstName,
        uf.FacLastName,
        uf.FacSalary,
        ABS(uf.FacSalary - ra.avg_salary) AS salary_diff,
        ra.avg_salary
    FROM university_faculty uf
    JOIN rank_avg ra
        ON uf.FacRank = ra.FacRank
),
closest_faculty AS (
    SELECT
        FacRank,
        MIN(salary_diff) AS min_diff
    FROM faculty_diff
    GROUP BY FacRank
)
SELECT
    fd.FacRank AS rank,
    fd.FacFirstName AS first_name,
    fd.FacLastName AS last_name,
    fd.FacSalary AS salary
FROM faculty_diff fd
JOIN closest_faculty cf
    ON fd.FacRank = cf.FacRank
   AND fd.salary_diff = cf.min_diff
ORDER BY fd.FacRank, fd.FacLastName, fd.FacFirstName;

WITH female_legislators AS (
  SELECT l.id_bioguide
  FROM legislators l
  WHERE l.gender = 'F'
),
first_state_per_legislator AS (
  SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.state, MIN(lt.term_start) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide
),
terms_including_dec31 AS (
  SELECT 
    lt.id_bioguide
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
      SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', lt.term_start) AS INTEGER) AS year_start,
             CAST(strftime('%Y', lt.term_end) AS INTEGER) AS year_end
    ) years,
    (
      SELECT 0 AS offset UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5
      UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10
      UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15
      UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20
    ) o
    WHERE (year_start + o.offset) BETWEEN year_start AND year_end
      AND (
        DATE((year_start + o.offset) || '-12-31') BETWEEN lt.term_start AND lt.term_end
      )
    LIMIT 1
  )
)
SELECT fsp.state, COUNT(DISTINCT fsp.id_bioguide) AS female_legislator_count
FROM female_legislators fl
JOIN first_state_per_legislator fsp ON fl.id_bioguide = fsp.id_bioguide
JOIN terms_including_dec31 tic ON fl.id_bioguide = tic.id_bioguide
GROUP BY fsp.state
ORDER BY female_legislator_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

top_skills AS (

relevant_jobs AS (

)
SELECT AVG(fj.salary_year_avg) AS overall_avg_salary

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT
        l.id_bioguide,
        MIN(lt.term_start) AS first_term_start
    FROM
        legislators l
        JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE
        DATE(lt.term_start) BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
    GROUP BY
        l.id_bioguide
),
periods AS (
    SELECT 1 AS period
    UNION ALL SELECT 2
    UNION ALL SELECT 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6
    UNION ALL SELECT 7
    UNION ALL SELECT 8
    UNION ALL SELECT 9
    UNION ALL SELECT 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 11
    UNION ALL SELECT 12
    UNION ALL SELECT 13
    UNION ALL SELECT 14
    UNION ALL SELECT 15
    UNION ALL SELECT 16
    UNION ALL SELECT 17
    UNION ALL SELECT 18
    UNION ALL SELECT 19
    UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
cohort_size AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM cohort
),
retention AS (
    SELECT
        p.period,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id_bioguide) AS retained
    FROM periods p
    CROSS JOIN cohort c
    LEFT JOIN legislators_terms lt
      ON lt.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
      AND DATE(lt.term_start) <= DATE(c.first_term_start, '+' || p.period || ' years', '-1 day')
      AND DATE(lt.term_end) >= DATE(c.first_term_start, '+' || p.period || ' years', '-1 day')
    WHERE lt.id_bioguide IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.period
)
SELECT
    p.period,
    COALESCE(r.retained, 0) AS retained_legislators,
    cs.total AS cohort_size,
    ROUND(COALESCE(r.retained, 0)*1.0/cs.total, 4) AS retention_rate
FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
LEFT JOIN retention r ON p.period = r.period
ORDER BY p.period

WITH legislator_cohorts AS (
  SELECT
    lg.id_bioguide,
    lg.gender,
    lt.state,
    MIN(DATE(lt.term_start)) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators lg
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON lg.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  WHERE lg.gender IN ('male', 'female')
  GROUP BY lg.id_bioguide, lt.state, lg.gender
),
intervals AS (
  SELECT 0 AS years UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
cohort_intervals AS (
  SELECT
    lc.id_bioguide,
    lc.gender,
    lc.state,
    DATE(lc.first_term_start, '+' || intervals.years || ' years') AS interval_date,
    intervals.years
  FROM legislator_cohorts lc
  CROSS JOIN intervals
),
served_on_interval AS (
  SELECT
    ci.id_bioguide,
    ci.gender,
    ci.state,
    ci.years,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
      WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ci.id_bioguide
        AND lt.state = ci.state
        AND DATE(lt.term_start) <= DATE(ci.interval_date, '-1 day')
        AND DATE(lt.term_end) > DATE(ci.interval_date, '-1 day')
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
  FROM cohort_intervals ci
),
retention_by_state_gender_years AS (
  SELECT
    state,
    gender,
    years,
    AVG(retained) AS retention_rate
  FROM served_on_interval
  GROUP BY state, gender, years
),
passing_states AS (
  SELECT
    state,
    gender
  FROM retention_by_state_gender_years
  WHERE retention_rate > 0
  GROUP BY state, gender
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT years) = 6
)
SELECT DISTINCT p1.state AS state_abbreviation
FROM passing_states p1
JOIN passing_states p2 ON p1.state = p2.state AND p1.gender = 'male' AND p2.gender = 'female'
ORDER BY state_abbreviation;

WITH la_male_legislators AS (

),
dec31_years AS (
  SELECT 
    l.id_bioguide,
    l.first_term_start,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) + n AS year_num,
    date((CAST(strftime('%Y', l.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) + n) || '-12-31') AS dec31_date,

  FROM la_male_legislators l
  JOIN (

    SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL
    SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL
    SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL
    SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL
    SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL
    SELECT 30 UNION ALL SELECT 31 UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL
    SELECT 35 UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39 UNION ALL
    SELECT 40 UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43 UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL
    SELECT 45 UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47 UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49
  ) n
  WHERE n.n > 30 AND n.n < 50
),
active_on_dec31 AS (
  SELECT
    d.years_elapsed,
    d.dec31_date,

  FROM dec31_years d
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON d.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  WHERE

)
SELECT

WITH first_purchase AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    MIN(p.payment_date) AS first_payment_date
  FROM customer c
  JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
ltv AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_ltv
  FROM customer c
  JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
sales_windows AS (
  SELECT 
    fp.customer_id,
    ltv.total_ltv,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%s', p.payment_date) AS INTEGER) <= CAST(STRFTIME('%s', fp.first_payment_date) AS INTEGER) + 7*24*60*60 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_7d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%s', p.payment_date) AS INTEGER) <= CAST(STRFTIME('%s', fp.first_payment_date) AS INTEGER) + 30*24*60*60 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_30d
  FROM first_purchase fp
  JOIN payment p ON fp.customer_id = p.customer_id
  JOIN ltv ON ltv.customer_id = fp.customer_id
  GROUP BY fp.customer_id, ltv.total_ltv, fp.first_payment_date
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN total_ltv > 0 THEN CAST(sales_7d AS FLOAT)/total_ltv ELSE NULL END) * 100 AS avg_pct_ltv_7d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN total_ltv > 0 THEN CAST(sales_30d AS FLOAT)/total_ltv ELSE NULL END) * 100 AS avg_pct_ltv_30d,
  AVG(total_ltv) AS avg_total_ltv
FROM sales_windows
WHERE total_ltv > 0;

WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue
    FROM film f
    JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
film_actor_count AS (
    SELECT
        fa.film_id,
        COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count
    FROM film_actor fa
    GROUP BY fa.film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        fa.actor_id,
        fa.film_id,
        fr.title,
        fr.total_revenue,
        fr.total_revenue * 1.0 / fac.actor_count AS revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
    JOIN film_actor_count fac ON fa.film_id = fac.film_id
),
ranked_films AS (
    SELECT
        afr.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY afr.actor_id ORDER BY afr.total_revenue DESC, afr.film_id) AS rn
    FROM actor_film_revenue afr
)
SELECT
    a.actor_id,
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,

    WHERE rn <= 3

first_movie_ratings AS (

customer_total_spend_and_rentals AS (

SELECT

WITH top_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (

    FROM payment p
    JOIN top_customers tc ON p.customer_id = tc.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, year_month
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT
        mp.customer_id,
        mp.year_month,
        mp.monthly_amount,
        LAG(mp.monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY mp.customer_id ORDER BY mp.year_month) AS prev_monthly_amount
    FROM monthly_payments mp
),
differences AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        year_month,
        ROUND(ABS(monthly_amount - prev_monthly_amount), 2) AS diff
    FROM monthly_changes
    WHERE prev_monthly_amount IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    year_month,
    diff AS max_monthly_difference
FROM differences
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH countries_with_many_customers AS (

country_sales AS (

ordered_sales AS (

monthly_rentals AS (

ranked_rentals AS (

WITH filtered_words AS (
  SELECT words AS word
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) IN (4,5) AND words GLOB 'r*'
),
word_sigs AS (
  SELECT word, LENGTH(word) as len, 
         (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c, '') FROM (
           SELECT SUBSTR(word, n, 1) as c
           FROM (SELECT 1 as n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) numbers
           WHERE n <= LENGTH(word)
           ORDER BY c
         )) AS signature
  FROM filtered_words
),
anagram_counts AS (
  SELECT signature, COUNT(*) as anagram_count
  FROM word_sigs
  GROUP BY signature
),
results AS (
  SELECT ws.word, ac.anagram_count
  FROM word_sigs ws
  JOIN anagram_counts ac ON ws.signature = ac.signature
  WHERE ac.anagram_count > 1
)
SELECT word, anagram_count
FROM results
ORDER BY word
LIMIT 10;

),
top_10_states AS (

feb_orders AS (

ordered_goals AS (

)

  SELECT id, home_team_api_id, away_team_api_id, home_team_goal, away_team_goal, home_player_3 FROM Match UNION ALL

  SELECT id, away_team_api_id, home_team_api_id, away_team_goal, home_team_goal, away_player_5 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, away_team_api_id, home_team_api_id, away_team_goal, home_team_goal, away_player_6 FROM Match UNION ALL

  SELECT id, away_team_api_id, home_team_api_id, away_team_goal, home_team_goal, away_player_8 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, away_team_api_id, home_team_api_id, away_team_goal, home_team_goal, away_player_9 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, away_team_api_id, home_team_api_id, away_team_goal, home_team_goal, away_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, away_team_api_id, home_team_api_id, away_team_goal, home_team_goal, away_player_11 FROM Match
),
AllPlayers AS (
  SELECT match_id, team_api_id, opp_team_api_id, home_team_goal AS team_goal, away_team_goal AS opp_goal, player_id
    FROM HomePlayers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT match_id, team_api_id, opp_team_api_id, team_goal, opp_goal, player_id
    FROM AwayPlayers
),
PlayerResults AS (
  SELECT player_id, 
         CASE 
           WHEN team_goal > opp_goal THEN 'win'
           WHEN team_goal < opp_goal THEN 'loss'
           ELSE 'draw'
         END AS result
  FROM AllPlayers
  WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL
    AND team_goal IS NOT NULL
    AND opp_goal IS NOT NULL
    AND team_goal != opp_goal -- exclude draws
),
WinCounts AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count
  FROM PlayerResults
  WHERE result = 'win'
  GROUP BY player_id
),
LossCounts AS (
  SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS loss_count
  FROM PlayerResults
  WHERE result = 'loss'
  GROUP BY player_id
),
MaxWin AS (
  SELECT player_id, win_count
  FROM WinCounts
  WHERE win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM WinCounts)
),
MaxLoss AS (
  SELECT player_id, loss_count
  FROM LossCounts
  WHERE loss_count = (SELECT MAX(loss_count) FROM LossCounts)
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT player_id FROM MaxWin LIMIT 1) AS highest_win_player_id,
  (SELECT win_count FROM MaxWin LIMIT 1) AS highest_win_count,
  (SELECT player_id FROM MaxLoss LIMIT 1) AS highest_loss_player_id,
  (SELECT loss_count FROM MaxLoss LIMIT 1) AS highest_loss_count;

    JOIN batsman_scored bs USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
  GROUP BY m.season_id, bb.striker
),
TopBatsmen AS (
  SELECT 
    season_id,
    player_id,
    total_runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY season_id 
      ORDER BY total_runs DESC, player_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM batsman_runs
),
filtered_wickets AS (
  SELECT 
    m.season_id,
    bb.bowler AS player_id
  FROM 
    ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    JOIN match m ON bb.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
),
bowler_wickets AS (
  SELECT 
    season_id,
    player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_wickets
  FROM filtered_wickets
  GROUP BY season_id, player_id
),
TopBowlers AS (
  SELECT 
    season_id,
    player_id,
    total_wickets,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY season_id 
      ORDER BY total_wickets DESC, player_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM bowler_wickets
),
SelectedBatsmen AS (
  SELECT * FROM TopBatsmen WHERE rn <= 3
),
SelectedBowlers AS (
  SELECT * FROM TopBowlers WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT
  sb.season_id,
  sb.player_id AS batsman_id,
  p1.player_name AS batsman_name,
  sb.total_runs,
  sw.player_id AS bowler_id,
  p2.player_name AS bowler_name,
  sw.total_wickets
FROM
  SelectedBatsmen sb
  JOIN SelectedBowlers sw
    ON sb.season_id = sw.season_id AND sb.rn = sw.rn
  JOIN player p1 ON sb.player_id = p1.player_id
  JOIN player p2 ON sw.player_id = p2.player_id
ORDER BY
  sb.season_id ASC, sb.rn ASC

WITH partnership_details AS (
    SELECT
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.striker AS player_a,
        bb.non_striker AS player_b,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND bb.striker = bs.match_id THEN bs.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS player_a_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND bb.non_striker = bs.match_id THEN bs.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS player_b_runs,
        COUNT(*) as balls_in_partnership -- surrogate partition key
    FROM
        ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY
        bb.match_id, bb.innings_no, bb.striker, bb.non_striker
),
partnership_scores AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        player_a,
        player_b,
        player_a_runs,
        player_b_runs,
        (player_a_runs + player_b_runs) AS partnership_runs
    FROM partnership_details
),
ordered_partners AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        CASE
            WHEN player_a_runs > player_b_runs THEN player_a
            WHEN player_a_runs < player_b_runs THEN player_b
            WHEN player_a_runs = player_b_runs AND player_a > player_b THEN player_a
            ELSE player_b
        END AS player_1_id,
        CASE
            WHEN player_a_runs > player_b_runs THEN player_b
            WHEN player_a_runs < player_b_runs THEN player_a
            WHEN player_a_runs = player_b_runs AND player_a > player_b THEN player_b
            ELSE player_a
        END AS player_2_id,
        CASE
            WHEN player_a_runs > player_b_runs THEN player_a_runs
            WHEN player_a_runs < player_b_runs THEN player_b_runs
            ELSE player_a_runs
        END AS player_1_runs,
        CASE
            WHEN player_a_runs > player_b_runs THEN player_b_runs
            WHEN player_a_runs < player_b_runs THEN player_a_runs
            ELSE player_b_runs
        END AS player_2_runs,
        partnership_runs
    FROM partnership_scores
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) AS max_partnership_runs FROM ordered_partners GROUP BY match_id
)
SELECT p.match_id, p.player_1_id, p.player_1_runs, p.player_2_id, p.player_2_runs, p.partnership_runs
FROM ordered_partners p
JOIN max_partnerships m ON p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = m.max_partnership_runs
ORDER BY p.match_id, p.player_1_id, p.player_2_id;

WITH durations AS (

    Track.TrackId,
    Track.Name,
    Track.Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS minutes
  FROM Track
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(minutes) AS min_time,
    MAX(minutes) AS max_time,
    AVG(minutes) AS avg_time,
    (MIN(minutes) + AVG(minutes)) / 2.0 AS mid_min_avg,
    (AVG(minutes) + MAX(minutes)) / 2.0 AS mid_avg_max
  FROM durations
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    d.TrackId,
    d.Name,
    d.minutes,
    CASE
      WHEN d.minutes >= s.min_time AND d.minutes < s.mid_min_avg THEN 'Short'
      WHEN d.minutes >= s.mid_min_avg AND d.minutes < s.mid_avg_max THEN 'Medium'
      WHEN d.minutes >= s.mid_avg_max AND d.minutes <= s.max_time THEN 'Long'
    END AS duration_category
  FROM durations d
  CROSS JOIN stats s
),
min_max_by_cat AS (
  SELECT
    duration_category,
    MIN(minutes) AS min_minutes,
    MAX(minutes) AS max_minutes
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY duration_category
),
revenue_by_cat AS (
  SELECT
    c.duration_category,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS total_revenue
  FROM classified c
  LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = c.TrackId
  GROUP BY c.duration_category
)
SELECT
  mm.duration_category,
  mm.min_minutes,
  mm.max_minutes,
  COALESCE(rbc.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue
FROM min_max_by_cat mm
LEFT JOIN revenue_by_cat rbc
  ON mm.duration_category = rbc.duration_category
ORDER BY
  CASE mm.duration_category
    WHEN 'Short' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Long' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END

WITH CleanedSalary AS (
    SELECT 
        CompanyName,
        Location,
        CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Salary, '$', ''), ',', ''), '₹', ''), ' ', '') AS FLOAT) AS Salary_numeric
    FROM SalaryDataset
    WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
          AND Salary IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(Salary) != ''
),
AverageSalaryByCompanyLocation AS (
    SELECT 
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        AVG(Salary_numeric) AS AvgSalaryInState
    FROM CleanedSalary
    GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
Top5CompaniesEachLocation AS (
    SELECT 
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        AvgSalaryInState,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Location ORDER BY AvgSalaryInState DESC) AS rn
    FROM AverageSalaryByCompanyLocation
),
NationalAverageByCompany AS (
    SELECT 
        CompanyName,
        AVG(Salary_numeric) AS AvgSalaryInCountry
    FROM CleanedSalary
    GROUP BY CompanyName
)
SELECT 
    t.Location,

    n.AvgSalaryInCountry
FROM Top5CompaniesEachLocation t
