WITH player_roles AS (
  SELECT
    pm.player_id,
    pm.role,
    COUNT(*) AS role_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pm.player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pm.role) AS rn
  FROM player_match pm
  GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
  SELECT player_id, role
  FROM player_roles
  WHERE rn = 1
),
batting_stats AS (
  SELECT
    b.striker AS player_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id) AS matches_played,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN w.player_out = b.striker THEN 1 END) AS dismissals,
    COUNT(*) AS balls_faced,
    MAX(bs.runs_scored) AS highest_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_30plus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_50plus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_100plus
  FROM batsman_scored bs
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON bs.match_id = w.match_id AND bs.innings_no = w.innings_no AND bs.over_id = w.over_id AND bs.ball_id = w.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.striker
),
bowling_stats AS (
  SELECT
    b.bowler AS player_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
    COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.player_out IS NOT NULL AND b.bowler = b.bowler THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_taken
  FROM batsman_scored bs
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON bs.match_id = w.match_id AND bs.innings_no = w.innings_no AND bs.over_id = w.over_id AND bs.ball_id = w.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowling_best_performance AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    wickets,
    runs_given
  FROM (
    SELECT
      b.bowler AS player_id,
      b.match_id,
      SUM(CASE WHEN w.player_out IS NOT NULL AND b.bowler = b.bowler THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
      SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_given,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.bowler ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN w.player_out IS NOT NULL AND b.bowler = b.bowler THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, SUM(bs.runs_scored)) AS rn
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON bs.match_id = w.match_id AND bs.innings_no = w.innings_no AND bs.over_id = w.over_id AND bs.ball_id = w.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  mfr.role AS most_frequent_role,
  p.batting_hand,
  p.bowling_skill,
  IFNULL(bs.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
  IFNULL(bs.matches_played, 0) AS matches_played,
  IFNULL(bs.dismissals, 0) AS dismissals,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN IFNULL(bs.dismissals, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE CAST(bs.total_runs AS REAL) / bs.dismissals
    END, 2
  ) AS batting_average,
  IFNULL(bs.highest_score, 0) AS highest_score,
  IFNULL(bs.matches_30plus, 0) AS matches_30plus,
  IFNULL(bs.matches_50plus, 0) AS matches_50plus,
  IFNULL(bs.matches_100plus, 0) AS matches_100plus,
  IFNULL(bs.balls_faced, 0) AS balls_faced,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN IFNULL(bs.balls_faced, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE CAST(bs.total_runs AS REAL) / bs.balls_faced * 100
    END, 2
  ) AS strike_rate,
  IFNULL(bws.wickets_taken, 0) AS wickets_taken,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN IFNULL(bws.balls_bowled, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE CAST(bws.runs_conceded AS REAL) / bws.balls_bowled * 6
    END, 2
  ) AS economy_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN bbp.wickets IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE
      CAST(bbp.wickets AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(bbp.runs_given AS TEXT)
  END AS best_bowling
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON mfr.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN batting_stats bs ON bs.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_stats bws ON bws.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_best_performance bbp ON bbp.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT 1000

WITH solution_counts AS (
    SELECT
        s.name AS problem_name,
        COUNT(*) AS solution_count
    FROM solution s
    GROUP BY s.name
),
model_scores AS (
    SELECT
        m.name AS problem_name,
        m.version,
        m.step,
        m.name AS model_name,
        ms.model AS model_alias,
        ms.test_score
    FROM model m
    JOIN model_score ms
      ON m.name = ms.name AND m.version = ms.version AND m.step = ms.step
    WHERE m.step IN (1,2,3)
),
stack_scores AS (
    SELECT
        problem_name,
        version,
        step,
        test_score AS stack_test_score
    FROM model_scores
    WHERE model_name = 'Stack'
),
max_non_stack_scores AS (
    SELECT
        problem_name,
        version,
        step,
        MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_scores
    WHERE model_name != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY problem_name, version, step
),
qualifying_problems AS (
    SELECT
        ms.problem_name
    FROM max_non_stack_scores ms
    JOIN stack_scores ss
      ON ms.problem_name = ss.problem_name AND ms.version = ss.version AND ms.step = ss.step
    WHERE ms.max_non_stack_score < ss.stack_test_score
    GROUP BY ms.problem_name, ms.version, ms.step
)
SELECT sc.problem_name
FROM solution_counts sc
WHERE sc.problem_name IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT problem_name FROM qualifying_problems
)
AND sc.solution_count > (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM solution s2
    WHERE s2.name = sc.problem_name
)
;

WITH step_scores AS (
    SELECT
        m.name AS model_name,
        m.version AS model_version,
        m.L1_model,
        m.step,
        ms.model AS L2_model,
        ms.test_score
    FROM model m
    JOIN model_score ms ON m.name = ms.name AND m.version = ms.version AND m.step = ms.step
),
stack_scores AS (
    SELECT
        model_name,
        model_version,
        step,
        test_score AS stack_test_score
    FROM step_scores
    WHERE L2_model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max_scores AS (
    SELECT
        model_name,
        model_version,
        step,
        MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack_score
    FROM step_scores
    WHERE L2_model <> 'Stack'
    GROUP BY model_name, model_version, step
),
status_by_model AS (
    SELECT
        ns.model_name,
        ns.model_version,
        ns.step,
        CASE
            WHEN ns.max_non_stack_score < ss.stack_test_score THEN 'strong'
            WHEN ns.max_non_stack_score = ss.stack_test_score THEN 'soft'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS status
    FROM non_stack_max_scores ns
    JOIN stack_scores ss
      ON ns.model_name = ss.model_name AND ns.model_version = ss.model_version AND ns.step = ss.step
),
model_primary_status AS (
    SELECT
        model_name,
        model_version,
        MAX(CASE status WHEN 'strong' THEN 2 WHEN 'soft' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_score
    FROM status_by_model
    GROUP BY model_name, model_version
),
model_status_label AS (
    SELECT
        model_name,
        model_version,
        CASE status_score WHEN 2 THEN 'strong' WHEN 1 THEN 'soft' ELSE NULL END AS status
    FROM model_primary_status
    WHERE status_score > 0
),
model_l1_status AS (
    SELECT
        m.model_name,
        m.model_version,
        m.L1_model,
        s.status
    FROM (
        SELECT name AS model_name, version AS model_version, L1_model FROM model
    ) m
    JOIN model_status_label s ON m.model_name = s.model_name AND m.model_version = s.model_version
),
l1_status_counts AS (
    SELECT
        L1_model,
        status,
        COUNT(*) AS occurrences
    FROM model_l1_status
    GROUP BY L1_model, status
),
ranked_l1 AS (
    SELECT
        l1_status_counts.status,
        l1_status_counts.L1_model,
        l1_status_counts.occurrences,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l1_status_counts.status ORDER BY l1_status_counts.occurrences DESC) AS rnk
    FROM l1_status_counts
)
SELECT
    status,
    L1_model,
    occurrences
FROM ranked_l1
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY status, L1_model

SELECT
    L1_model,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM model
WHERE L1_model IN ('Stack', 'Traditional')
GROUP BY L1_model
ORDER BY total_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RECURSIVE expanded_packaging AS (
  -- Each packaging and the contents it directly contains
  SELECT
    pr.packaging_id AS root_packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id AS leaf_packaging_id,
    pr.qty AS factor
  FROM packaging_relations pr

  UNION ALL

  -- Expand: for each child that is also a parent, go deeper
  SELECT
    ep.root_packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    ep.factor * pr.qty AS factor
  FROM expanded_packaging ep
  JOIN packaging_relations pr ON ep.leaf_packaging_id = pr.packaging_id
)
, leaf_packaging AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.contains_id
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  LEFT JOIN packaging_relations as parent_pr ON pr.contains_id = parent_pr.packaging_id
  WHERE parent_pr.packaging_id IS NULL
)
, packaging_totals AS (
  SELECT ep.root_packaging_id, SUM(ep.factor) AS total_qty
  FROM expanded_packaging ep
  JOIN leaf_packaging l ON ep.leaf_packaging_id = l.contains_id
  GROUP BY ep.root_packaging_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_qty) AS average_leaf_quantity_per_final_packaging
FROM packaging_totals

WITH inventory_fifo AS (
    SELECT
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        i.product_id,
        i.location_id,
        i.qty AS inventory_qty,
        p.purchased AS purchase_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.product_id
            ORDER BY p.purchased ASC, i.qty ASC
        ) AS fifo_rank
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
),
ordered_fifo AS (
    SELECT
        ol.id AS orderline_id,
        ol.order_id,
        ol.product_id,
        ol.qty AS ordered_qty
    FROM orderlines ol
),
pick_matches AS (
    SELECT
        ofo.orderline_id,
        inf.inventory_id,
        ofo.product_id,
        MIN(inf.inventory_qty, ofo.ordered_qty) AS picked_qty
    FROM ordered_fifo ofo
    JOIN inventory_fifo inf ON ofo.product_id = inf.product_id
    WHERE ofo.ordered_qty > 0 AND inf.inventory_qty > 0
),
orderline_pick_pct AS (
    SELECT
        pm.product_id,
        SUM(pm.picked_qty) AS total_picked_qty,
        SUM(ofo.ordered_qty) AS total_ordered_qty
    FROM pick_matches pm
    JOIN ordered_fifo ofo ON pm.orderline_id = ofo.orderline_id
    GROUP BY pm.product_id
)
SELECT
    pr.name AS product_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(opc.total_picked_qty * 1.0) / NULLIF(SUM(opc.total_ordered_qty),0), 0) AS avg_pick_percentage
FROM orderline_pick_pct opc
JOIN products pr ON opc.product_id = pr.id
GROUP BY pr.name
ORDER BY pr.name;

WITH fifo_picks AS (
  SELECT
    pl.id AS picking_list_id,
    pl.picker_emp_id,
    pl.created AS picking_time,
    pl.product_id,
    pl.qty AS picking_qty,
    s.symbol AS stock_symbol,
    s.company AS stock_company
  FROM picking_list pl
  JOIN stock s ON pl.stock_symbol = s.symbol
  WHERE pl.order_id = 421
),
product_names AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name AS product_name
  FROM products p
)
SELECT
  fp.product_id,
  pn.product_name,
  AVG(fp.picking_qty) AS avg_units_picked_fifo
FROM fifo_picks fp
JOIN product_names pn ON fp.product_id = pn.product_id
GROUP BY fp.product_id, pn.product_name
ORDER BY MIN(fp.picking_time)

WITH monthly_sales_indexed AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    mth,
    qty AS sales,
    CAST(substr(mth, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(substr(mth, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY product_id 
      ORDER BY mth
    ) AS month_idx
  FROM monthly_sales
  WHERE mth >= '2016-01'
),
-- 12-month centered moving average: window 1 (5 before, 6 after)
cma_window1 AS (
  SELECT
    ms1.product_id,
    ms1.mth,
    ms1.year,
    ms1.month,
    ms1.sales,
    ms1.month_idx,
    AVG(ms2.sales) AS cma1
  FROM monthly_sales_indexed ms1
  JOIN monthly_sales_indexed ms2
    ON ms1.product_id = ms2.product_id
    AND ms2.month_idx BETWEEN ms1.month_idx-5 AND ms1.month_idx+6
  GROUP BY ms1.product_id, ms1.mth, ms1.year, ms1.month, ms1.sales, ms1.month_idx
),
-- 12-month centered moving average: window 2 (6 before, 5 after)
cma_both AS (
  SELECT
    w1.product_id,
    w1.mth,
    w1.year,
    w1.month,
    w1.sales,
    w1.month_idx,
    w1.cma1,
    AVG(w2.sales) AS cma2
  FROM cma_window1 w1
  JOIN monthly_sales_indexed w2
    ON w1.product_id = w2.product_id
    AND w2.month_idx BETWEEN w1.month_idx-6 AND w1.month_idx+5
  GROUP BY w1.product_id, w1.mth, w1.year, w1.month, w1.sales, w1.month_idx, w1.cma1
),
sales_cma_ratio AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    mth,
    year,
    month,
    month_idx,
    sales,
    (cma1 + cma2)/2.0 AS cma,
    sales / NULLIF((cma1 + cma2)/2.0, 0) AS ratio
  FROM cma_both
),
all_2017_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    COUNT(*) AS months_in_2017,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ratio > 2) AS months_above_2
  FROM sales_cma_ratio
  WHERE year = 2017
    AND month_idx BETWEEN 7 AND 30
  GROUP BY product_id
  HAVING months_in_2017 = 12 AND months_above_2 = 12
)
SELECT
  p.id AS product_id,
  p.name AS product_name
FROM all_2017_ratios ar
JOIN products p ON ar.product_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.id;

WITH MatchPoints AS (
    SELECT
        m.season,
        l.name AS league_name,
        c.name AS country_name,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        m.season,
        l.name AS league_name,
        c.name AS country_name,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
),
TeamTotalPoints AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_name,
        country_name,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM MatchPoints
    GROUP BY season, league_name, country_name, team_api_id
),
ChampionTeams AS (
    SELECT
        ttp.season,
        ttp.league_name,
        ttp.country_name,
        ttp.team_api_id,
        ttp.total_points,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ttp.season, ttp.league_name, ttp.country_name
            ORDER BY ttp.total_points DESC
        ) AS rk
    FROM TeamTotalPoints ttp
)
SELECT
    ct.season,
    ct.league_name,
    ct.country_name,
    tm.team_long_name AS champion_team_name,
    ct.total_points
FROM ChampionTeams ct
JOIN Team tm ON ct.team_api_id = tm.team_api_id
WHERE ct.rk = 1
ORDER BY ct.country_name, ct.league_name, ct.season;

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG([loss_rate_%]) AS avg_loss_rate,
        AVG(([loss_rate_%] - (SELECT AVG([loss_rate_%]) FROM veg_loss_rate_df)) * ([loss_rate_%] - (SELECT AVG([loss_rate_%]) FROM veg_loss_rate_df))) AS var_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
stds AS (
    SELECT 
        avg_loss_rate, 
        SQRT(var_loss_rate) AS std_loss_rate
    FROM stats
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        v.item_code,
        v.item_name,
        v.[loss_rate_%],
        s.avg_loss_rate,
        s.std_loss_rate,
        CASE 
            WHEN v.[loss_rate_%] >= s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_loss_rate
             AND v.[loss_rate_%] <= s.avg_loss_rate + s.std_loss_rate THEN 'within_1std'
            WHEN v.[loss_rate_%] < s.avg_loss_rate - s.std_loss_rate THEN 'below_1std'
            ELSE 'above_1std'
        END AS category
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stds s
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stds) AS average_loss_rate,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'below_1std' THEN 1 END) AS count_below_1std,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'within_1std' THEN 1 END) AS count_within_1std,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'above_1std' THEN 1 END) AS count_above_1std
FROM classified;

WITH whsle AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', whsle_date) AS year,
        c.category_name,
        v."whsle_px_rmb-kg" AS wholesale_price,
        v.item_code
    FROM veg_whsle_df v
    JOIN veg_cat c ON v.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE strftime('%Y', whsle_date) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
),
loss_data AS (
    SELECT
        item_code,
        ROUND(AVG("loss_rate_%"), 2) AS avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
    GROUP BY item_code
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        w.year,
        w.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MIN(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(w.wholesale_price) - MIN(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
        ROUND(SUM(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
        -- Selling price = wholesale_price * (1 + avg_loss_rate/100)
        ROUND(SUM(w.wholesale_price * (1 + IFNULL(l.avg_loss_rate,0)/100)), 2) AS total_selling_price,
        ROUND(AVG(IFNULL(l.avg_loss_rate,0)), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
        ROUND(SUM(w.wholesale_price * IFNULL(l.avg_loss_rate,0)/100), 2) AS total_loss,
        ROUND(SUM(w.wholesale_price * (1 + IFNULL(l.avg_loss_rate,0)/100)) - SUM(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS profit
    FROM
        whsle w
        LEFT JOIN loss_data l ON w.item_code = l.item_code
    GROUP BY w.year, w.category_name
)
SELECT 
    year,
    category_name AS category,
    avg_wholesale_price,
    max_wholesale_price,
    min_wholesale_price,
    wholesale_price_difference,
    total_wholesale_price,
    total_selling_price,
    avg_loss_rate,
    total_loss,
    profit
FROM agg
ORDER BY year, category;

WITH seller_product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    p.product_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_products_sold,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
    AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id, p.product_category_name
),
seller_agg AS (
  SELECT
    sps.seller_id,
    (
      SELECT pct.product_category_name_english
      FROM seller_product_sales sps2
      JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON sps2.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
      WHERE sps2.seller_id = sps.seller_id
      ORDER BY sps2.total_products_sold DESC, sps2.product_category_name
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS top_category_english,
    SUM(sps.total_sales) AS total_sales,
    AVG(sps.avg_item_price) AS avg_item_price,
    SUM(sps.total_products_sold) AS total_products_sold
  FROM seller_product_sales sps
  GROUP BY sps.seller_id
  HAVING SUM(sps.total_products_sold) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
  SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(r.review_score * 1.0) AS avg_review_score
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN order_reviews r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing_times AS (
  SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    AVG(
      JULIANDAY(oi.shipping_limit_date) - JULIANDAY(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
    ) AS avg_packing_days
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
)
SELECT
  sa.seller_id,
  sa.total_sales,
  sa.avg_item_price,
  sr.avg_review_score,
  spt.avg_packing_days,
  sa.total_products_sold,
  sa.top_category_english AS highest_sales_category_english
FROM seller_agg sa
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sa.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing_times spt ON sa.seller_id = spt.seller_id
ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC

WITH txn_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date)) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_amount
    FROM
        customer_transactions
    GROUP BY
        customer_id, month
),
txn_cumsum AS (
    SELECT
        t1.customer_id,
        t1.month,
        SUM(t2.net_amount) AS closing_balance
    FROM
        txn_monthly t1
        JOIN txn_monthly t2
          ON t1.customer_id = t2.customer_id
         AND t2.month <= t1.month
    GROUP BY
        t1.customer_id, t1.month
),
latest_months AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month AS latest_month,
        closing_balance AS latest_balance,
        LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_balance
    FROM
        txn_cumsum
),
most_recent_month AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        latest_month,
        latest_balance,
        prev_balance
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY latest_month DESC) as rn
        FROM latest_months
    ) sub
    WHERE rn = 1
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(prev_balance, 0) = 0 THEN latest_balance * 100
            ELSE ((latest_balance - prev_balance) * 1.0 / ABS(prev_balance)) * 100
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM
        most_recent_month
)
SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS pct_customers_growth_over_5
FROM
    growth_rates;

WITH ordered_txns AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    DATE(txn_date) AS txn_date, 
    txn_type, 
    txn_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
),
signed_txns AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    txn_date, 
    CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END AS amount
  FROM ordered_txns
),
daily_txns AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    txn_date, 
    SUM(amount) AS daily_net
  FROM signed_txns
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
all_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, txn_date FROM daily_txns
  UNION
  SELECT customer_id, DATE(min_date, '+' || seq || ' day') AS txn_date
  FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) AS min_date, MAX(txn_date) AS max_date FROM daily_txns GROUP BY customer_id
  ) b
  JOIN (
    SELECT 0 seq UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
    UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19
    UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29
    UNION SELECT 30 UNION SELECT 31 UNION SELECT 32 UNION SELECT 33 UNION SELECT 34 UNION SELECT 35 UNION SELECT 36 UNION SELECT 37 UNION SELECT 38 UNION SELECT 39
    UNION SELECT 40 UNION SELECT 41 UNION SELECT 42 UNION SELECT 43 UNION SELECT 44 UNION SELECT 45 UNION SELECT 46 UNION SELECT 47 UNION SELECT 48 UNION SELECT 49
  ) s
  WHERE DATE(min_date, '+' || seq || ' day') <= max_date
),
daily_balance AS (
  SELECT
    d.customer_id,
    d.txn_date,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT SUM(d2.daily_net)
      FROM daily_txns d2
      WHERE d2.customer_id = d.customer_id AND d2.txn_date <= d.txn_date
    ), 0) AS running_balance
  FROM all_days d
),
windowed_balance AS (
  SELECT
    b1.customer_id,
    b1.txn_date,
    (
      SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN running_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE running_balance END)
      FROM daily_balance b2
      WHERE b2.customer_id = b1.customer_id
        AND b2.txn_date <= b1.txn_date
        AND b2.txn_date > DATE(b1.txn_date, '-30 days')
    ) AS avg_30d_balance,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)
      FROM daily_balance b2
      WHERE b2.customer_id = b1.customer_id
        AND b2.txn_date <= b1.txn_date
        AND b2.txn_date > DATE(b1.txn_date, '-30 days')
    ) AS day_count
  FROM daily_balance b1
),
filtered_avg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    CASE WHEN day_count = 30 THEN avg_30d_balance ELSE NULL END AS avg_30d_balance
  FROM windowed_balance
),
first_months AS (
  SELECT customer_id, SUBSTR(MIN(txn_date),1,7) AS first_month FROM daily_balance GROUP BY customer_id
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT
    f.customer_id,
    SUBSTR(f.txn_date,1,7) AS month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.avg_30d_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE f.avg_30d_balance END) AS max_30d_avg
  FROM filtered_avg f
  JOIN first_months fm ON f.customer_id = fm.customer_id
  WHERE SUBSTR(f.txn_date,1,7) != fm.first_month AND f.avg_30d_balance IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY f.customer_id, SUBSTR(f.txn_date,1,7)
),
monthly_sum AS (
  SELECT month, SUM(max_30d_avg) AS monthly_total
  FROM monthly_max
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, monthly_total
FROM monthly_sum
ORDER BY month;

WITH txn_dates AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(txn_date) AS min_date,
        MAX(txn_date) AS max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT
        td.customer_id,
        date(td.min_date, '+' || n.n || ' day') AS day
    FROM txn_dates td
    JOIN (
        SELECT a.n * 100 + b.n * 10 + c.n AS n
        FROM (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) a
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) b
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) c
    ) n
    WHERE date(td.min_date, '+' || n.n || ' day') <= td.max_date
),
txn_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        txn_amount
    FROM customer_transactions
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT
        ad.customer_id,
        ad.day,
        COALESCE(ta.txn_amount, 0) AS txn_amount
    FROM all_dates ad
    LEFT JOIN txn_amounts ta
        ON ad.customer_id = ta.customer_id AND ad.day = ta.txn_date
),
running_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        day,
        MAX(0, 
            SUM(txn_amount) OVER (
                PARTITION BY customer_id
                ORDER BY day
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            )
        ) AS daily_balance
    FROM daily_balances
),
month_max_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', day) AS year_month,
        MAX(daily_balance) AS max_daily_balance_in_month
    FROM running_balances
    GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
)
SELECT
    year_month,
    SUM(max_daily_balance_in_month) AS monthly_total_max_balance
FROM month_max_balances
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month;

WITH week_labeled AS (
  SELECT
    week_date,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', week_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    'before' AS period
  FROM weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date BETWEEN date(strftime('%Y', week_date) || '-06-15', '-28 days') AND date(strftime('%Y', week_date) || '-06-15', '-1 day')
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', week_date) AS INTEGER) IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    week_date,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', week_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    'after' AS period
  FROM weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date BETWEEN date(strftime('%Y', week_date) || '-06-15', '+1 day') AND date(strftime('%Y', week_date) || '-06-15', '+28 days')
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', week_date) AS INTEGER) IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
),
agg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    wl.year,
    wl.period,
    SUM(ws.sales) AS total_sales
  FROM week_labeled wl
  JOIN weekly_sales ws ON ws.week_date = wl.week_date
  GROUP BY wl.year, wl.period
)
SELECT
  before.year,
  ROUND((after.total_sales - before.total_sales)*100.0 / before.total_sales, 2) AS pct_change
FROM
  (SELECT * FROM agg_sales WHERE period = 'before') before
  JOIN
  (SELECT * FROM agg_sales WHERE period = 'after') after
  ON before.year = after.year
ORDER BY before.year;

WITH label_weeks AS (
  SELECT
    week_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN week_date >= '2020-03-23' AND week_date <= '2020-06-07' THEN 'before'
      WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' AND week_date <= '2020-08-31' THEN 'after'
      ELSE NULL
    END as period
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date BETWEEN '2020-03-23' AND '2020-08-31'
  GROUP BY week_date
),
attr_types AS (
  SELECT 'region' as attr UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type'
),
attrs_sales AS (
  SELECT 'region' as attr_type, region as attr_value, l.period, SUM(sales) as total_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales s 
    JOIN label_weeks l ON s.week_date = l.week_date
    WHERE l.period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY region, l.period
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform', platform, l.period, SUM(sales) 
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales s 
    JOIN label_weeks l ON s.week_date = l.week_date 
    WHERE l.period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY platform, l.period
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band', age_band, l.period, SUM(sales) 
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales s 
    JOIN label_weeks l ON s.week_date = l.week_date 
    WHERE l.period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY age_band, l.period
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic', demographic, l.period, SUM(sales) 
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales s 
    JOIN label_weeks l ON s.week_date = l.week_date 
    WHERE l.period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY demographic, l.period
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type', customer_type, l.period, SUM(sales) 
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales s 
    JOIN label_weeks l ON s.week_date = l.week_date 
    WHERE l.period IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_type, l.period
),
attrs_pivot AS (
  SELECT 
    attr_type, attr_value,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period='before' THEN total_sales END) as before_sales,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period='after' THEN total_sales END) as after_sales
  FROM attrs_sales
  GROUP BY attr_type, attr_value
),
attr_pct_change AS (
  SELECT 
    attr_type,
    attr_value,
    before_sales,
    after_sales,
    CASE 
      WHEN before_sales>0 THEN CAST(after_sales-before_sales AS REAL)/before_sales
      ELSE NULL
    END as pct_change
  FROM attrs_pivot
)
SELECT attr_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
FROM attr_pct_change
GROUP BY attr_type
ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH driver_yearly_points AS (
  SELECT
    r.year,
    ds.driver_id,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
    SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
  JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
  GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id
),
max_driver_points AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    MAX(total_points) AS max_points
  FROM driver_yearly_points
  GROUP BY year
),
top_drivers AS (
  SELECT
    dyp.year,
    dyp.driver_full_name,
    dyp.total_points
  FROM driver_yearly_points dyp
  JOIN max_driver_points mdp ON dyp.year = mdp.year AND dyp.total_points = mdp.max_points
),
constructor_yearly_points AS (
  SELECT
    r.year,
    cs.constructor_id,
    c.name AS constructor_name,
    SUM(cs.points) AS total_points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
  JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
  GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
max_constructor_points AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    MAX(total_points) AS max_points
  FROM constructor_yearly_points
  GROUP BY year
),
top_constructors AS (
  SELECT
    cyp.year,
    cyp.constructor_name,
    cyp.total_points
  FROM constructor_yearly_points cyp
  JOIN max_constructor_points mcp ON cyp.year = mcp.year AND cyp.total_points = mcp.max_points
)
SELECT
  td.year,
  td.driver_full_name AS top_driver,
  td.total_points AS driver_points,
  tc.constructor_name AS top_constructor,
  tc.total_points AS constructor_points
FROM top_drivers td
JOIN top_constructors tc ON td.year = tc.year
ORDER BY td.year;

WITH driver_totals AS (
  SELECT ra.year, re.driver_id, SUM(re.points) AS total_driver_points
  FROM results re
  JOIN races ra ON re.race_id = ra.race_id
  GROUP BY ra.year, re.driver_id
),
max_driver AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(total_driver_points) AS max_driver_points
  FROM driver_totals
  GROUP BY year
),
constructor_totals AS (
  SELECT ra.year, re.constructor_id, SUM(re.points) AS total_constructor_points
  FROM results re
  JOIN races ra ON re.race_id = ra.race_id
  GROUP BY ra.year, re.constructor_id
),
max_constructor AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(total_constructor_points) AS max_constructor_points
  FROM constructor_totals
  GROUP BY year
),
year_sums AS (
  SELECT d.year, d.max_driver_points + c.max_constructor_points AS total
  FROM max_driver d
  JOIN max_constructor c ON d.year = c.year
)
SELECT year, total
FROM year_sums
ORDER BY total ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH season_final_race AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(round) AS final_round
  FROM races
  GROUP BY year
),
constructor_team_points AS (
  SELECT cs.constructor_id, r.year, cs.points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
  JOIN season_final_race sfr ON r.year = sfr.year AND r.round = sfr.final_round
),
driver_points AS (
  SELECT d.constructor_id, r.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points
  FROM driver_standings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
  JOIN season_final_race sfr ON r.year = sfr.year AND r.round = sfr.final_round
  JOIN drives d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id AND r.year = d.year
),
best_driver_by_constructor AS (
  SELECT constructor_id, year, MAX(points) AS best_driver_points
  FROM driver_points
  GROUP BY constructor_id, year
),
combined_points AS (
  SELECT ctp.constructor_id, ctp.year, ctp.points + COALESCE(bdb.best_driver_points,0) AS combined_pts
  FROM constructor_team_points ctp
  LEFT JOIN best_driver_by_constructor bdb ON ctp.constructor_id = bdb.constructor_id AND ctp.year = bdb.year
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor, cp.year, cp.combined_pts
FROM combined_points cp
JOIN constructors c ON cp.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY cp.combined_pts DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH ordered_visits AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    action,
    stamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as rn
  FROM access_log
  WHERE action IN ('/regist/input', '/regist/confirm')
),
input_visits AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    rn as input_rn
  FROM ordered_visits
  WHERE action = '/regist/input'
),
confirm_visits AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    rn as confirm_rn
  FROM ordered_visits
  WHERE action = '/regist/confirm'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.session) as unique_sessions
FROM input_visits i
JOIN confirm_visits c
  ON i.session = c.session
  AND i.input_rn < c.confirm_rn
;

WITH session_pages AS (
    SELECT
        session,
        MIN(stamp) AS first_ts,
        MAX(stamp) AS last_ts
    FROM activity_log
    GROUP BY session
),
landing_pages AS (
    SELECT
        a.session,
        a.path
    FROM activity_log a
    JOIN session_pages sp
        ON a.session = sp.session AND a.stamp = sp.first_ts
),
exit_pages AS (
    SELECT
        a.session,
        a.path
    FROM activity_log a
    JOIN session_pages sp
        ON a.session = sp.session AND a.stamp = sp.last_ts
),
landing_exit_union AS (
    SELECT session, path FROM landing_pages
    UNION
    SELECT session, path FROM exit_pages
)
SELECT
    path AS page,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS unique_session_count
FROM landing_exit_union
GROUP BY page
ORDER BY unique_session_count DESC, page;

WITH seasons_since_2001 AS (
    SELECT year
    FROM seasons
    WHERE year >= 2001
),
driver_season_points AS (
    -- Aggregate total points for each driver in each season, with constructor
    SELECT d.driver_id, r.constructor_id, ra.year, SUM(r.points) AS total_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
    JOIN seasons_since_2001 s ON ra.year = s.year
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driver_id = d.driver_id
    GROUP BY d.driver_id, r.constructor_id, ra.year
    HAVING total_points > 0
),
min_point_scorers AS (
    -- For each season, find the minimum points scored (by point scorers)
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) AS min_pts
    FROM driver_season_points
    GROUP BY year
),
min_point_scorer_ctors AS (
    -- For each season, find the constructor corresponding to the driver(s) with the minimum points
    SELECT dsp.year, dsp.constructor_id
    FROM driver_season_points dsp
    JOIN min_point_scorers mps ON dsp.year = mps.year AND dsp.total_points = mps.min_pts
    GROUP BY dsp.year, dsp.constructor_id
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor_name, COUNT(*) AS seasons_with_least_point_scorer
FROM min_point_scorer_ctors mpsc
JOIN constructors c ON mpsc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY seasons_with_least_point_scorer DESC, constructor_name ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH first_five_laps AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, lap
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap BETWEEN 1 AND 5
),
driver_lap_positions AS (
    SELECT
        lp.race_id,
        lp.lap,
        lp.driver_id,
        lp.position,
        LAG(lp.position) OVER (
            PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap
        ) as prev_position
    FROM lap_positions lp
    JOIN first_five_laps ffl ON lp.race_id = ffl.race_id AND lp.lap = ffl.lap
),
potential_overtakes AS (
    SELECT
        dl1.race_id,
        dl1.lap,
        dl1.driver_id AS overtaker_id,
        dl1.position AS overtaker_pos,
        dl2.driver_id AS overtaken_id,
        dl2.position AS overtaken_pos,
        dl1.prev_position AS overtaker_prev,
        dl2.prev_position AS overtaken_prev
    FROM driver_lap_positions dl1
    JOIN driver_lap_positions dl2
        ON dl1.race_id = dl2.race_id
        AND dl1.lap = dl2.lap
        AND dl1.position + 1 = dl2.position
        AND dl1.prev_position > dl2.prev_position
    WHERE dl1.prev_position IS NOT NULL AND dl2.prev_position IS NOT NULL
),
retirements_lap AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap FROM retirements WHERE lap IS NOT NULL
),
pitstops_thislap AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap FROM pit_stops
),
pitstops_prev_lap AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap+1 AS lap FROM pit_stops
),
grid_positions AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, grid FROM results
),
overtake_classified AS (
    SELECT
        po.race_id,
        po.lap,
        CASE
            -- Retirement
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM retirements_lap r
                WHERE r.race_id = po.race_id AND r.driver_id = po.overtaken_id AND r.lap = po.lap
            ) THEN 'R'
            -- Pit entry
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM pitstops_thislap p
                WHERE p.race_id = po.race_id AND p.driver_id = po.overtaken_id AND p.lap = po.lap
            ) THEN 'P'
            -- Pit exit
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM pitstops_prev_lap p
                WHERE p.race_id = po.race_id AND p.driver_id = po.overtaken_id AND p.lap = po.lap
            ) THEN 'P'
            -- Start related (lap 1, grid diff <= 2)
            WHEN po.lap = 1 AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM grid_positions g1
                JOIN grid_positions g2
                    ON g1.race_id = g2.race_id
                WHERE g1.race_id = po.race_id
                  AND g1.driver_id = po.overtaker_id
                  AND g2.driver_id = po.overtaken_id
                  AND ABS(g1.grid - g2.grid) <= 2
            ) THEN 'S'
            -- Standard Track Overtake
            ELSE 'T'
        END AS category
    FROM potential_overtakes po
)
SELECT
    category,
    COUNT(*) AS overtake_count
FROM overtake_classified
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

WITH lap_data AS (
  SELECT 
    lt.race_id,
    lt.driver_id,
    lt.lap,
    lt.position,
    LAG(lt.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lt.race_id, lt.driver_id ORDER BY lt.lap) AS prev_position
  FROM lap_times lt
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps WHERE ps.race_id = lt.race_id
  )
),
overtake_candidates AS (
  -- Find for each lap and race, position changes indicating a driver is now behind another (new overtake state)
  SELECT
    curr.race_id,
    curr.lap,
    curr.driver_id AS overtaking_driver,
    prev.driver_id AS overtaken_driver,
    curr.position AS curr_position,
    prev.position AS prev_position,
    curr.prev_position AS overtaker_prev_position,
    prev.prev_position AS overtaken_prev_position
  FROM lap_data curr
  JOIN lap_data prev
    ON curr.race_id = prev.race_id
    AND curr.lap = prev.lap
    AND curr.driver_id <> prev.driver_id
    AND curr.position = prev.position + 1 -- curr is now behind prev
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lap_data pl_curr
    JOIN lap_data pl_prev
      ON pl_curr.race_id = pl_prev.race_id
      AND pl_curr.lap = curr.lap - 1
      AND pl_prev.lap = curr.lap - 1
      AND pl_curr.driver_id = curr.driver_id
      AND pl_prev.driver_id = prev.driver_id
      AND pl_curr.position = pl_prev.position + 1
  )
),
pit_entry_overtakes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    oc.race_id,
    oc.lap,
    oc.overtaking_driver,
    oc.overtaken_driver,
    'P' AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates oc
  INNER JOIN pit_stops ps
    ON ps.race_id = oc.race_id
    AND ps.driver_id = oc.overtaken_driver
    AND ps.lap = oc.lap
),
pit_exit_overtakes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    oc.race_id,
    oc.lap,
    oc.overtaking_driver,
    oc.overtaken_driver,
    'P' AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates oc
  INNER JOIN pit_stops ps
    ON ps.race_id = oc.race_id
    AND ps.driver_id = oc.overtaken_driver
    AND ps.lap = oc.lap - 1
),
retirement_overtakes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    oc.race_id,
    oc.lap,
    oc.overtaking_driver,
    oc.overtaken_driver,
    'R' AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates oc
  INNER JOIN retirements r
    ON r.race_id = oc.race_id
    AND r.driver_id = oc.overtaken_driver
    AND r.lap = oc.lap
),
start_overtakes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    oc.race_id,
    oc.lap,
    oc.overtaking_driver,
    oc.overtaken_driver,
    'S' AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates oc
  INNER JOIN results res_over ON res_over.race_id = oc.race_id AND res_over.driver_id = oc.overtaking_driver
  INNER JOIN results res_ovek ON res_ovek.race_id = oc.race_id AND res_ovek.driver_id = oc.overtaken_driver
  WHERE oc.lap = 1 AND ABS(res_over.grid - res_ovek.grid) <= 2
),
labelled_overtakes AS (
  SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver, label FROM retirement_overtakes
  UNION
  SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver, label FROM pit_entry_overtakes
  UNION
  SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver, label FROM pit_exit_overtakes
  UNION
  SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver, label FROM start_overtakes
  UNION
  -- Track overtakes: not classed above
  SELECT
    oc.race_id,
    oc.lap,
    oc.overtaking_driver,
    oc.overtaken_driver,
    'T' AS label
  FROM overtake_candidates oc
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver FROM retirement_overtakes
    UNION
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver FROM pit_entry_overtakes
    UNION
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver FROM pit_exit_overtakes
    UNION
    SELECT race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver FROM start_overtakes
  ) labelled USING (race_id, lap, overtaking_driver, overtaken_driver)
  WHERE labelled.race_id IS NULL
)
SELECT
  label,
  COUNT(*) AS overtake_count
FROM labelled_overtakes
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY label

WITH races_50s AS (
  SELECT race_id, year, round
  FROM races
  WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_50s_races AS (
  SELECT 
    res.driver_id, 
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, 
    r.year, 
    res.race_id, 
    res.constructor_id, 
    r.round
  FROM results res
  JOIN races_50s r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
),
driver_year_rounds AS (
  SELECT
    driver_id,
    driver_name,
    year,
    MIN(round) AS first_round,
    MAX(round) AS last_round,
    COUNT(DISTINCT round) AS n_rounds
  FROM driver_50s_races
  GROUP BY driver_id, driver_name, year
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round) >= 2
),
driver_year_first_last_constructors AS (
  SELECT
    dyr.driver_id,
    dyr.driver_name,
    dyr.year,
    MIN(fr.constructor_id) AS first_constructor_id,
    MIN(lr.constructor_id) AS last_constructor_id
  FROM driver_year_rounds dyr
  JOIN driver_50s_races fr ON fr.driver_id = dyr.driver_id AND fr.year = dyr.year AND fr.round = dyr.first_round
  JOIN driver_50s_races lr ON lr.driver_id = dyr.driver_id AND lr.year = dyr.year AND lr.round = dyr.last_round
  GROUP BY dyr.driver_id, dyr.driver_name, dyr.year
  HAVING first_constructor_id = last_constructor_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT driver_name
FROM driver_year_first_last_constructors
ORDER BY driver_name;

WITH driver_race_team AS (
    SELECT
        res.driver_id,
        r.year,
        r.round,
        r.race_id,
        res.constructor_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY res.driver_id, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY res.driver_id, r.year) AS num_entries
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
),
all_driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT driver_id, year
    FROM results
    JOIN races ON results.race_id = races.race_id
),
race_list AS (
    SELECT r.race_id, r.year, r.round FROM races r
),
missed_races AS (
    SELECT
        ads.driver_id,
        ads.year,
        rl.round
    FROM all_driver_seasons ads
    JOIN race_list rl ON rl.year = ads.year
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT driver_id, year, round FROM driver_race_team
    ) drt ON drt.driver_id = ads.driver_id AND drt.year = ads.year AND drt.round = rl.round
    WHERE drt.round IS NULL
),
grouped_missed AS (
    SELECT
        driver_id,
        year,
        round,
        round - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driver_id, year ORDER BY round) AS grp
    FROM missed_races
),
missed_ranges AS (
    SELECT
        driver_id,
        year,
        MIN(round) AS first_missed_round,
        MAX(round) AS last_missed_round,
        COUNT(*) AS num_missed
    FROM grouped_missed
    GROUP BY driver_id, year, grp
),
filtered_ranges AS (
    SELECT * FROM missed_ranges
    WHERE num_missed < 3
),
before_after_team_switches AS (
    SELECT
        fr.*,
        (SELECT constructor_id FROM driver_race_team drt WHERE drt.driver_id = fr.driver_id AND drt.year = fr.year AND drt.round = fr.first_missed_round - 1 ORDER BY drt.round DESC LIMIT 1) AS before_constructor,
        (SELECT constructor_id FROM driver_race_team drt WHERE drt.driver_id = fr.driver_id AND drt.year = fr.year AND drt.round = fr.last_missed_round + 1 ORDER BY drt.round ASC LIMIT 1) AS after_constructor
    FROM filtered_ranges fr
),
team_switch_hiatuses AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM before_after_team_switches
    WHERE before_constructor IS NOT NULL
      AND after_constructor IS NOT NULL
      AND before_constructor <> after_constructor
)
SELECT
    AVG(first_missed_round * 1.0) AS avg_first_missed_round,
    AVG(last_missed_round * 1.0) AS avg_last_missed_round
FROM team_switch_hiatuses;

WITH filtered_lap_times AS (
  SELECT lt.race_id, lt.driver_id, lt.lap, lt.position
  FROM lap_times lt
  WHERE lt.lap > 1
),
valid_lap_times AS (
  SELECT flt.*
  FROM filtered_lap_times flt
  LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps
    ON flt.race_id = ps.race_id
    AND flt.driver_id = ps.driver_id
    AND flt.lap = ps.lap
  LEFT JOIN retirements r
    ON flt.race_id = r.race_id
    AND flt.driver_id = r.driver_id
    AND flt.lap = r.lap
  WHERE ps.driver_id IS NULL AND r.driver_id IS NULL
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    prev.driver_id AS overtaken_id,
    curr.driver_id AS overtaker_id
  FROM valid_lap_times prev
  JOIN valid_lap_times curr
    ON prev.race_id = curr.race_id
    AND prev.lap = curr.lap
    AND prev.position = curr.position + 1
),
overtaken_count AS (
  SELECT overtaken_id AS driver_id, COUNT(*) AS overtaken_events
  FROM overtakes
  GROUP BY overtaken_id
),
overtaker_count AS (
  SELECT overtaker_id AS driver_id, COUNT(*) AS overtaker_events
  FROM overtakes
  GROUP BY overtaker_id
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN overtaken_count oc ON d.driver_id = oc.driver_id
LEFT JOIN overtaker_count ok ON d.driver_id = ok.driver_id
WHERE IFNULL(oc.overtaken_events, 0) > IFNULL(ok.overtaker_events, 0);

SELECT 
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM mst_users
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category;

WITH first_event AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    MIN(stamp) AS first_target_stamp
  FROM activity_log
  WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/complete')
  GROUP BY session
),
pre_click_events AS (
  SELECT
    a.session,
    a.path,
    a.search_type,
    a.stamp
  FROM activity_log a
  LEFT JOIN first_event f
    ON a.session = f.session
  WHERE
    TRIM(a.search_type) != ''
    AND (f.first_target_stamp IS NULL OR a.stamp < f.first_target_stamp)
),
pre_click_counts AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
  FROM pre_click_events
  GROUP BY session
),
min_count AS (
  SELECT MIN(event_count) AS min_event_count FROM pre_click_counts
)
SELECT
  e.session,
  e.path,
  e.search_type
FROM pre_click_events e
JOIN pre_click_counts c ON e.session = c.session
JOIN min_count m ON c.event_count = m.min_event_count
ORDER BY e.session, e.stamp
